item.title: Thailand approves $122 million in flood relief after 19 deaths
item.description: Government spokesperson Ekkapob Pianpises said the approved 4.1 billion baht would be distributed by the Interior Ministry to affected areas.

item.title: Survey finds Gen Z and baby boomers differ on protein supplements
item.description: Younger consumers are incorporating protein into more foods, including powders, bars, cereal and soda.

item.title: U.S. bans nearly $1 billion in Canadian imports, mostly alcohol
item.description: The ban also covers dairy and motorcycles, intensifying a trade dispute that experts say could last for months.

item.title: OpenAI launches 'dots' to compete with Meta's Muse, plus $500 monthly plan
item.description: At its annual DevDay event, the company introduced more than 20 new products aimed at rivals including Meta, Google, and Anthropic.
